title: Gold eases back from record as traders await Fed verdict
summary: Gold slipped from recent record highs on Tuesday as traders squared positions ahead of Wednesday's Federal Reserve decision, with spot XAU/USD quoted near $4,283 an ounce against a backdrop of elevated US 10-year real yields. Market commentary points to persistent central bank buying and structurally tight positioning as supportive factors, while a hotter-than-expected rate signal from the Fed could re-test recent lows in the short term.
